provenance: Written by Larry’s son while curating the 2026-08-13 Memories comments, summarising what Larry had said. Not his own wording; the comments themselves are archived separately.
text: "You son of a bitch! You killed 450 civilians down there" — Lowry's words as Larry remembers them. "Wherever down there was, I never saw any of this... I immediately thought something was not kosher." Larry adds that he later heard a mass grave of 450 civilians was found at the base of the mountain after the war, and says he wonders whether he was set up as a scapegoat.
